lines: It has always been a pleasure to serve as a board member of the Redstone Music and Arts Center.
I’m honored that the board has recommended me as vice president.
However, because my work schedule is expected to change, I must turn down the recommendation.
I don’t think I can give the time and energy that the vice president should give to the center.
However, I do look forward to carrying on as a regular board member.
Please give my regrets to the rest of the board.
body.text: Dear Mr. Denning, It has always been a pleasure to serve as a board member of the Redstone Music and Arts Center. I’m honored that the board has recommended me as vice president. However, because my work schedule is expected to change, I must turn down the recommendation. I don’t think I can give the time and energy that the vice president should give to the center. However, I do look forward to carrying on as a regular board member. Please give my regrets to the rest of the board. Sincerely, Jason Becker.
